description:
## Current delivery contract — user-approved two-outcome stack
Owner: PR A. One PR per complete outcome, NOT one PR per bead. Keep detailed beads and cohesive internal commits for tracking; consolidate existing draft foundations into their owning feature PR where practical. PR B stacks on independently usable PR A. Include owning PR documentation and validation there. This supersedes earlier per-bead/prerequisite PR instructions and historical comments. Closed foundation status is not outcome acceptance.
New-feature E2E requires explicit human UX approval in zaq-emb.12; no self-approval.

Outbound email evidence slice after .14.2.2. Extend the existing SmtpSender delivery boundary (no duplicate send operation) to expose actual sender identity and explicit SMTP envelope recipient only after confirmed delivery, including IMAP-bound connector selection, while preserving legacy callers expecting :ok/error. EmailBridge reply receipt attaches sender copy and this message recipient evidence; no retroactive thread audience. Tests FIRST on SmtpSender and EmailBridge for actual from settings/override, failed send no history evidence, multi-account selection/ambiguity, Bcc and bot reply, plus property recipient isolation. Read Channels and system-config guides before touching settings/secrets; no new Action/agent tool and no new-feature E2E before UX approval.
title: [zaq-emb.14.2.4] Return confirmed SMTP history evidence
